# Gravemire Stalker

*Medium undead, chaotic evil*

**Armor Class** 15 (natural armor)
**Hit Points** 52 (8d8 + 16)
**Speed** 30 ft.

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 16 (+3) | 14 (+2) | 14 (+2) | 9 (-1) | 11 (+0) | 8 (-1) |

**Saving Throws** Wis +2, Cha +1
**Skills** Perception +2, Stealth +4
**Damage Resistances** necrotic
**Senses** darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12

## Abilities

**Undead Fortitude.** If damage reduces the stalker to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw against a DC equal to the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the stalker drops to 1 hit point instead.

**Passive Trait.** The stalker has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made in dim light or darkness.

## Actions

**Multiattack.** The stalker makes two melee attacks.

**Rotting Claw.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

**Wailing Howl** (Recharge 5-6). Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13. The stalker emits a horrifying wail. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it and fails the save takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage, or half as much on a successful one.

## Reactions

**Sudden Lurch.** When a creature within 5 feet of the stalker hits it with a melee attack, the stalker can use its reaction to move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see within 30 feet of it.
